name: 鸳鸯风云录——白中悬案(Phoenix sword: The Hidden Scroll)
detailed_description:
"When the Phoenix sword's blades unite, their edge will bring tremors through the empire."

——————————————————————————————————————————————

Story Introduction

In the third year of the Chongzhen era (1630), the order of the Ming Empire had already collapsed. Famine, war, and banditry relentlessly ravaged this land.

In an utopian "Baichu County", a murder shocks the town — a local tyrant, "Baye", is found dead in his mansion. The investigative bureau immediately dispatches detective — Yue Wuxi and Feng Shengjue to investigate.

What appears to be a simple vendetta unravels a mystery from thirteen years ago, which deeply tied to Yue's own sect.

Entangled in fifty years of love, hatred and vengeance, they must choose between justice in the name of "chivalry" or the shadowy path of deception.

And... who is the hidden hand of the conspiracy?

Character Introduction

Yue Wuxi

CV: Ran Yue Tsuki

The fourth-generation leader of the Xuanyuan Sect. After his master's death, he felt lost about the sect's future and join the investigative bureau as a detective. While investigating the truth of mystery about Bai family thirdteen years ago and searching his junior sister,  he becomes a partner with his colleague Feng Shengjue. They solve numerous baffling cases and earning widespread fame.

Feng Shengjue

CV:Teng Zi

The "Crown Prince" of the Assassin, planted as a spy within the investigative bureau. Having grown up in the Assassin, he is solitary, ruthless and burdened by the mystery of his origins. After becoming the partner of Yue Wuxi, he gradually begins to question the "rules" he once rigidly followed and forge his own fate.

Bai Xing

CV:Ling Dongdong

The daughter of Feng Niang, the second leader of Meixian Sect. After his parents died, she was adopted by the master, Wei Daozi, and joined Xuanyuan Sect. However, due to a misunderstanding, she left Xuanyuan sect. With fierce and decisive, she has spent years seeking vengeance against the true murderer of her parents.

Bai Yun

CV:Wang Mingyue

The son of Feng Niang. Thirteen years ago, he was struck off a cliff by the murderer but survived. After the Battle of Dongshan, he joined Yuan Chonghuan's forces but resigned because killing a secret police and receiving clues about his sister. Now, he arrives in Baichu to find her.

Ai Nengxian

CV:Guan Chao

The magistrate of Baichu and the sworn brother of Li Hongji. Righteous, Virtuous and incorrupt, he single-handedly turned Baizhong into a "small paradise". He deeply embraces Li’s idea of an "ideal world" and strives to realize it.

What Kind of Game Is This?

"Phoenix sword: The Hidden Scroll" is a visual novel game and the first installment in the Phoenix sword trilogy. It unveils a grand tale of court intrigue and martial arts conflict centered around the legendary "Phoenix Sword". Every choice the player makes will alter the course of history—sometimes, even the smallest decision can lead to great consequences.

What Makes This Game Unique?

"Phoenix sword: The Hidden Scroll" draws inspiration from classic wuxia novels and Hong Kong cinema, blending the essence of golden-age martial arts literature and film with contemporary storytelling. It crafts a rich, historically grounded wuxia world for players to immerse themselves in.
